products.description:
Replace VPN trust with identity- and context-aware zero-trust access

Network location is not identity — a device inside the VPN isn't automatically trustworthy. This solution implements BeyondCorp Enterprise zero-trust access: Access Context Manager access levels (identity + device + context), Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) in front of web apps and VMs, context-aware access bindings, and device-trust signals — so access is granted per-request on who and what, not where, with no VPN.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the zero-trust model: Access Context Manager access levels, Identity-Aware Proxy, context-aware access, device signals, and how it relates to Workspace Context-Aware Access.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Organization, Cloud Identity, target apps/VMs, device signal source, admin roles).
  • Implementation Guide — define access levels, front a pilot app/VM with IAP, bind context-aware access, add device-trust signals, and validate deny/allow — then expand and retire VPN paths, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (access granted on identity+context, denied otherwise, VPN path retired) plus Best Practices for expanding zero-trust coverage.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Access granted on identity and context, not network location — apps and VMs behind Identity-Aware Proxy, context-aware levels enforced, VPN trust retired — true zero trust.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • bce_access_assessment.py — read-only BeyondCorp Enterprise zero-trust readiness assessment
    • bce_iap_enable_helper.py — enable Identity-Aware Proxy for a web app or a VM (SSH), dry-run by default
    • bce_policy_guardrail_check.py — zero-trust guardrail / posture check (read-only gate)
    • bce_scope_config_helper.py — build access levels (dry-run) OR export the zero-trust scope inventory
    • bce_zerotrust_validation_report.py — deny/allow validation report for an IAP-protected resource

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
